chapter: Family follow-ups from the first reels
title: Uncle Ernest Royal as clarinet teacher
summary: Ernest was a saxophone and clarinet player who learned the Boehm system and was Royal's only clarinet teacher.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the first horn: clarinet and saxophone beginnings

blocks.x: I don't think we ever really fully established in talking about your Uncle Ernest Royal, what his instrument was, (inaudible) that he gave you a clarinet.
Primarily, he was a saxophone and clarinet player. He was an excellent clarinet player and he's the one that actually taught me how to play clarinet. He was my only teacher as a clarinet player.

He started on the ________ system. My father taught him how to play clarinet, playing the Albert (PHONETIC) system. Then he learned how to play the Boehm (PHONETIC) system and taught my father how to play the Boehm system.
And he in turn was my only teacher.
He was about three years younger than my father.
And you said that everybody in your father's band played several instruments.
My uncle played trumpet and clarinet and saxophone.
